description: List every character currently present in the Studio scene, with its stable id, display name, card full name, sex, visibility, transform (pos/rot euler/scale), current animation, kinematic mode, face state, hand shapes and expression category flags. This is the tool to call to read back the result of studio_set_character_pose, studio_set_character_anime, studio_set_character_expression and studio_set_character_hands.

id.description: stable scene object id (Studio dicObjectCtrl key)

anime.description: current base animation; group/category/no round-trip into studio_set_character_anime

normalized_time.description: live sample of the Animator's normalized time — it keeps growing while a looping clip plays, so it does not round-trip into studio_set_character_anime as a stable value

is_anime_motion.description: the loaded clip declares a variation, so 'pattern' actually reaches the animator

is_h_anime.description: the loaded clip takes the two option parameters; when false they are stored but do nothing

kinematic.description: posing state; all fields round-trip into studio_set_character_kinematics

mode.description: the chain currently driving the skeleton; FK and IK are mutually exclusive, 'none' means the animation drives it

ik_groups.description: per-limb IK switches; a group only has a visible effect while mode is 'ik'

fk_groups.description: per-part FK switches; a group only has a visible effect while mode is 'fk'. 'body' covers the whole skeleton except the parts listed separately (arms and legs are body bones)

eyebrows.description: index in the eyebrow pattern list, -1 if the current pattern is not in it

hands.description: hand shapes; 'left' and 'right' round-trip into studio_set_character_hands

count.description: number of hand shapes installed; valid range for 'left'/'right' is 0..count, -1 when the shape list is not loaded

expression.description: expression category toggles; the index of each entry is the key used by studio_set_character_expression's 'expression_categories'
